name: finance-app
description: Full-stack personal finance tracker with budgets, pots, and transaction management using Supabase

paragraphs: A full-stack personal finance tracking application built with React Router v7 and Supabase. Track income and expenses, manage budgets, set savings goals, and visualize spending patterns.

Supabase provided a way to quickly set up a customizable backend without building a database layer from scratch. It offers PostgreSQL with an auto-generated API while still allowing full control over schema and business logic through triggers and functions.
TypeScript is standard for type safety in modern development.
features: Transaction Management - Track income, expenses, and transfers with detailed categorization
Budget Planning - Set monthly budgets by category with visual spending analytics
Savings Goals (Pots) - Create and track progress toward financial goals
Recurring Transactions - Manage subscription-based and regular payments
Smart Filtering - Filter transactions by category, type, and search query with sort options
